prompt:
Image 1 is a pixel-art sprite sheet of the legs of a small chibi character for a top-down 2D game, in one row of 2 figures standing still: the first faces down and to the right, the second faces up and to the right. Redraw this sheet exactly, with the same layout, the same 2 figures in the same positions, the same size, the same chunky pixel-art style with the same pixel size, the same black outline, the same soft top-left light, and the same flat solid pure magenta background, RGB 255,0,255. Do not move, resize or re-pose the legs. Every hip, knee and foot stays on exactly the same pixels as in Image 1.

Keep the very dark plain trousers on the hips and the thighs exactly as they are, with the same straight waist line at the top of each figure.

Change only the lower legs and the feet, below the knees: replace the silver knee guards and the brown boots with heavy black iron greaves: dark grey iron plates over each shin with a rounded iron knee plate, and big heavy black iron boots with a thick sole. Each boot stands on the same pixels as the brown boot it replaces and keeps nearly the same outline.

Do not include: a belt, a skirt, a waist guard, arms, hands, a torso, a head, weapons, shields, text, labels, numbers, grid lines, ground, shadows, dust, effects, borders, watermark, or any other object. No soft gradients, blur or painterly rendering.
